_comment: Run template for the lbnl-sdahu catalog entry. `camber datasets config lbnl-sdahu --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. Hourly resample and a 20% design-minimum OA reproduce the LBNL benchmark's SDAHU scoring (examples/lbnl_fdd/benchmark.py); every scenario is an equipment AHU__<scenario>, so one run scores them all.
